contract: Crafting (docs/design/craft_server_2026-10-12.md, 게임성 검수 OK 10/12; the hammer = Shared/CraftMini): switch Config.Features.Crafting off; Neutral only, the role's recipes only (Warrior Smith / Mage Alch / Archer Tame); 12 studs from the role's workbench (tag CraftStation, else the anvil); auto combat off; 6 starts a minute; craft Lv / materials / gold / room; gold (Craft) + materials at the start, Craft.Pend saved; CraftSession { Id, Recipe, 5, 1.2, 0.35, StartAt = server + 0.8 }; CraftStrike timed by the server, in order, >= 0.25 s apart; a claim beyond 250 ms + jitter (CraftMini: server ms - client ms outside -50 .. 250 + 1.5 x the biggest ping) = Miss; |ms - 40| <= 70 / 130 / 200; points >= 13 +2, >= 9 +1; five equal claims +0 (CraftBot); time-up / leave / KO +0; Pend at join finishes at +0 (stays while there is no room, retried at the next start); the result to the spares (AddSpare); W7 / W9 off until Clatter Gem / Royal Jelly / T9; craft XP per role 40 x Lv^1.5, Lv30 cap, not doubled; CraftResult / CraftInfo; key-only notices.
limitations: AddSpare / SpareRoom are doubles until 게임성 개발 2's C1 (Spares, v4); gear (⑥), tonics (④) and pet treats (⑤) add recipe rows later; the client hammer (게임성 개발 4) is played by the test from the offsets; no real network jitter. Artisan fame (Rep, ⑦) is not counted yet.
